description:
⚡ EOEOTWO EX1 Electric Dirt Bike

Experience the thrill of true off-road freedom with the EOEOTWO EX1 Electric Dirt Bike. Powered by a 3000W high-performance motor, this electric motorcycle reaches speeds of up to 40 MPH, giving you the confidence to tackle trails, dirt roads, gravel paths, and open terrain with ease. Built with premium components, a long-range battery, and rugged suspension, the EX1 is designed for riders who demand power, comfort, and reliability.

⚡ Powerful 3000W Motor

Unleash serious performance with the 3000W high-output brushless motor, delivering instant acceleration and outstanding climbing capability. Whether you're exploring off-road trails or enjoying weekend adventures, the EX1 offers the power you need to ride with confidence.

Climbs inclines up to 15°
Smooth and responsive throttle control
🔋 Ride Farther with a 50-Mile Range

Adventure doesn't stop early. The removable 48V 25Ah ternary lithium battery provides an impressive up to 50 miles of riding range on a single charge (depending on rider weight, terrain, and riding conditions).

Designed to handle rugged terrain, the EX1 features 17-inch heavy-duty off-road tires, generous 10.2-inch ground clearance, and a reinforced iron-core steel frame that provides exceptional durability and stability.

🛡️ Hydraulic Suspension & Dual Disc Brakes

Enjoy a smoother, more controlled ride on uneven terrain. The EX1 combines a dual hydraulic suspension system with front and rear hydraulic disc brakes to maximize comfort, handling, and stopping power.

Stay informed and visible wherever you ride. The integrated LED display keeps essential riding information within easy view, while the complete lighting package improves safety during day and night rides.

Every component of the EX1 is built with durability in mind. Its heavy-duty steel frame delivers exceptional stability for demanding rides while maintaining a balanced riding experience.

Ride with peace of mind knowing the EOEOTWO EX1 is built to meet recognized electrical safety standards. The complete electrical system is UL 2849 certified, helping provide dependable performance and enhanced rider confidence.

🌟 Why Choose the EOEOTWO EX1?

✔ 3000W high-performance brushless motor

✔ Up to 40 MPH top speed

✔ Up to 50 miles of riding range

✔ 17" heavy-duty off-road tires

✔ Front & rear hydraulic disc brakes

✔ Dual hydraulic suspension

✔ Smart LED display

✔ Complete LED lighting system

✔ 330 lbs maximum payload

✔ UL 2849 Certified electrical system

Whether you're conquering rugged trails, exploring the outdoors, or simply looking for an exciting electric ride, the EOEOTWO EX1 delivers the performance, durability, and confidence to take every adventure further.
